notes.title: New version released
notes.notes:
New version released

Fixes:
- Ship no longer jitters while moving and getting hit by an enemy projectile
-Movement type 3 no longer shifts sprite when pressing directional keys
New Feature:
- Player ship blinks red with every hit

notes.title: AMA - Chat with developer
notes.notes:
Join me for a chat on June 18th at 2 PM EST on either the game's discord server, Steam Chat or simply ask questions via twitter regarding my indie game Volatile!

I will be available for about 2 hours and will also be looking at the forums throughout the Steam Game Festival event, ending on the 22nd!

Hope to see you there!
